input.command:
python3 <<'PY'
from PIL import Image

src = "/home/airy/.cursor/projects/home-airy-mikasa/assets/vampire-rabbit-beer-bottle-neck-grip.webp"
dst = "/home/airy/mikasa/out/html/img/floppington_kitty.webp"

target_w, target_h = 240, 300

img = Image.open(src).convert("RGBA")
src_w, src_h = img.size
scale = max(target_w / src_w, target_h / src_h)
new_w = round(src_w * scale)
new_h = round(src_h * scale)
resized = img.resize((new_w, new_h), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
left = (new_w - target_w) // 2
top = (new_h - target_h) // 2
cropped = resized.crop((left, top, left + target_w, top + target_h))
cropped.save(dst, "WEBP", quality=85, method=6)
print(f"Saved {dst} ({cropped.size[0]}x{cropped.size[1]})")
PY
